items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: He told me that George Gershwin used to be his copyist... I met Bill... He played Rhapsody in Blue... George Gershwin jumped on the stage and kissed him after he got through playing it.

ctx.x: George Gershwin jumped on the stage and kissed him after he got through playing it.
Is that so? Where was that at?
